title: The Valley of Echoes
subtitle: Where your own voice comes back at you wrong

intro.text: Beyond the sea the road narrows into a valley where every sound returns to you — but never exactly as you said it.
Here I use your voice, Believer. I have listened to you for thirty levels. I know precisely what you think of yourself.
And yet the loudest thing in this valley is not the accusation. It is the answer given to it.
The fourth Power Verse is that answer. Restore it, and the echoes will have nothing left to twist.

levels.title: The Voice That Isn't Yours

dialogue.text: You speak your own name into the valley. It comes back as an accusation.
You have done worse than the people you judge, Believer. I have the list. I have always had the list.
You cannot argue with the list. You can only agree with it.
There is one thing that answers a list like that, and it is not a defence. Rebuild it.

levels.mission: Rebuild the answer that answers every accusation.

puzzle.verse: If we ____ our sins, he is faithful and just to ____ us our sins.
hints: The first blank is the opposite of hiding.
The second blank is what He does, not what He considers.
puzzle.reveal: "If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness." — 1 John 1:9

levels.title: The Two Debtors

dialogue.text: There's a crossroads here. Both roads have signs. Both signs have my name on them.
Take the one that feels honest, Believer. Regret is the most honest road.
Regret is honest. It is just not the destination. Choose the answer that was actually given.
One of these has 'therefore' in it. Keeper Miriam says 'therefore' means the hard part is finished.

levels.mission: Choose the verdict that was actually pronounced.

puzzle.prompt: "There is therefore now no ____ to them which are in Christ Jesus."
hints: It is a legal word — a verdict, not a feeling.
It is the thing the Shadow has been reading off its list.
puzzle.reveal: "There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit." — Romans 8:1

levels.title: The Echo Lattice
levels.setting: Morning eleven, the valley starts spelling back

dialogue.text: The valley begins spelling back at you — across and down, the words tangled into each other.
Your own words, Believer. Every one you have ever said about yourself. Now untangle them.
Then we will replace them with the words that were spoken over you. Across. And down.
I'll read the clues out loud. Echoes can only repeat what you give them!

levels.mission: Rebuild the lattice that overwrites the echoes.

clues.clue: "Blessed are the ____: for they shall obtain mercy"
"...sealed with that holy Spirit of promise"

hints: MERCY runs across the second row.
CROSS crosses MERCY, and SEAL crosses PEACE.
puzzle.reveal: "As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us." — Psalm 103:12

levels.title: Shattered by the Echo
levels.setting: Morning sixteen, the page comes back broken

dialogue.text: You read the verse aloud and the valley throws it back in the wrong order — on purpose.
I only moved the pieces. You are the one who memorised them wrong.
Then say them correctly, Believer. Loudly, and in the order they were first given.
Put them back. I'll hold the lantern steady.

levels.mission: Rebuild the promise in its spoken order.

puzzle.prompt: Arrange the promise as it was first spoken.
items: Being confident of this very thing,
that he which hath begun a good work in you
until the day of Jesus Christ
correctOrder: Being confident of this very thing,
that he which hath begun a good work in you
until the day of Jesus Christ
hints: It starts with confidence, not doubt.
The last piece is a date, not a person.
puzzle.reveal: "Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ." — Philippians 1:6

levels.title: The Accuser, Face to Face
levels.setting: Morning twenty-four, the valley goes silent

dialogue.text: For the first time the valley goes completely silent. The Shadow steps out wearing a shape you recognise.
It is your own face, Believer. It has always been. I only borrowed it so you would listen.
Four verses. One left. And this last one is the one you will not believe about yourself.
Then believe it anyway. The words are scattered through the silence. Find them.
I'm not scared of it anymore! It only looks like you!
Find them, Believer. The whole valley is listening for the sound of you winning.

levels.mission: Match the word pairs spoken over you.

hints: Find each matching pair of words.
Remember where you saw each word.
puzzle.reveal: Grace, mercy, chosen, ransomed, heir — the Accuser has no vocabulary for any of them. The fourth Power Verse is restored.
